Senior PM — Self-serve Analytics, London hybrid.

Metricly (900 employees) sells a business-analytics platform. Most revenue comes from enterprise contracts closed by field sales, but we also run a free self-serve tier that anyone can sign up for, and it drives a third of new pipeline. We're hiring a Senior PM to own self-serve activation: free signup to first dashboard, upgrade prompts and in-product trials. No direct reports. Hybrid, two days a week.

label_v2.edge_note: enterprise filter does NOT fire (PLG signal); self-serve activation is a direct match and PLG SaaS is a target industry, so P1
